paragraphs.en: We present an AI-assisted Lean 4 formalization of the Poincaré conjecture. The project began with limited reusable formal infrastructure for the geometric analysis behind the proof. To organize this work, we combined a proof blueprint prepared by mathematicians with explicit milestone statements. These milestones enabled parallel agent work and gave mathematicians clear points to locate blockers and provide effective mathematical guidance. Our analysis identifies the human interventions and organizational choices behind this workflow. The project provides a starting point toward reusable infrastructure for future formalization projects; such infrastructure, once developed, could eventually reduce the cost of verifying mathematical results in geometric analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种由人工智能辅助的、基于 Lean 4 的庞加莱猜想形式化方法。 该项目初期可用的可复用形式化基础设施，对于支撑证明过程的几何分析而言十分有限。 为了组织这项研究，我们将数学家们预先制定的证明蓝图与明确的关键里程碑陈述相结合。 这些关键里程碑使得智能体能够并行开展工作，同时也为数学家提供了清晰的定位障碍点和提供有效数学指导的依据。 我们的分析揭示了这一工作流程背后的人类干预和组织决策。 该项目为未来的形式化项目构建可复用基础设施提供了一个起点；一旦此类基础设施开发完成，最终将有助于降低几何分析中数学结果验证的成本。

paragraphs.en: Checking a proof is one of the most common and demanding tasks in mathematics, and it becomes especially difficult when the argument spans several fields. Recently, AI has greatly accelerated the production of proofs, making reliable verification ever more important. Proof assistants such as Lean 4 [ 13 ] verify proofs by rewriting a mathematical argument into precise formal code that the computer mechanically checks, thereby ensuring soundness. Although such systems have incorporated automation to reduce the burden of formalization, constructing formal code still requires extensive manual effort and expertise. Recent advances have enabled large language models to formalize, reducing this manual burden, and only very recently have they become capable of doing so at scale. Once a generated formal proof has passed kernel checking under the permitted axioms, the remaining human task is to judge whether its statement, assumptions, and definitions are semantically faithful to the original mathematical content; a reviewer can then verify the result without reconstructing every proof step or mastering every technique used to establish it. Still, expert guidance can be of great help throughout the formalization process in choosing definitions, reviewing statements, assessing code organization, and resolving mathematical difficulties during proof construction.
paragraphs.zh: 验证证明是数学中最常见且最具挑战性的任务之一，而当论证跨越多个领域时，这一过程会变得更加困难。 最近，人工智能极大地加速了证明的生成过程，使得可靠的验证变得愈发重要。 Lean 4 [ 13 ] 等证明助手通过将一个数学论证重写为计算机能够机械检查的精确形式化代码来验证证明，从而确保其正确性。 尽管这类系统已引入自动化手段以减轻形式化的负担，但构建形式化代码仍然需要大量的人工投入和专业技能。 近期的进展使大型语言模型具备了形式化能力，从而减轻了这一人工负担，而直到最近它们才真正能够大规模地执行这项任务。 一旦生成的形式化证明在允许的公理体系下通过了核心检查，人类剩下的工作就是判断其命题、假设和定义是否在语义上忠实于原始的数学内容；这样，审阅者便无需重构每一步证明或掌握所有用于建立该证明的技术，即可验证结果。 尽管如此，在整个形式化过程中，专家的指导仍能在选择定义、审查命题、评估代码结构以及解决证明构建过程中的数学难题方面提供极大的帮助。

paragraphs.en: Early work on autoformalization studied the translation of mathematical statements [ 53 , 26 , 18 ] , alongside progress in generating formal proofs [ 38 , 54 , 40 ] . As language models have become increasingly capable of producing proofs in natural language, the bottleneck has shifted from constructing a proof to translating it into formal code. This shift has enabled an end-to-end pipeline spanning generation, translation, and formal verification, which agent systems sustain through library retrieval, compiler feedback, and repeated task execution [ 47 , 30 , 28 ] . In parallel, the scale of projects that autoformalization can handle has grown from individual proofs to bodies of interrelated results and textbook-level theories [ 49 , 52 , 19 ] . The September 2026 formalization of Fermat’s Last Theorem using Prove2Me produced a complete computer-checked proof of unprecedented scale [ 9 , 2 ] , but how such large-scale formalizations are actually organized, and where human and AI effort is divided, is not yet widely understood.
paragraphs.zh: 早期的自动形式化研究关注数学命题的翻译 [ 53 , 26 , 18 ]，同时也在生成形式化证明方面取得了进展 [ 38 , 54 , 40 ]。 随着语言模型在自然语言中生成证明的能力日益增强，瓶颈已从构造证明转变为将其翻译成形式化代码。 这一转变使得一个涵盖生成、翻译和形式化验证的端到端流程成为可能，智能体系统通过库检索、编译器反馈和重复任务执行来维持这一流程 [ 47 , 30 , 28 ]。 与此同时，自动形式化所能处理的项目规模已从单个证明扩展至相互关联的结果集合以及教科书级别的理论体系 [ 49 , 52 , 19 ]。 2026年9月使用Prove2Me对费马大定理进行的形式化工作，生成了一份规模空前、经计算机完整验证的证明 [ 9 , 2 ]，但这类大规模形式化的具体组织方式以及人类与AI工作的分工，目前尚未被广泛理解。

paragraphs.en: We use the formalization of the Poincaré conjecture as a testing ground for these questions, a project whose scale and scope make it unusually demanding for organizing human and AI effort. The conjecture, proved by Perelman, states that every simply connected, closed three-manifold is homeomorphic to the three-sphere. We follow Morgan–Tian’s detailed exposition [ 32 ] . The proof requires geometric analysis for which Mathlib still lacks mature reusable interfaces, making the building of foundations an essential part of the project.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将庞加莱猜想的正式化作为这些问题的一种测试平台，而这一项目的规模与范围使其在组织人类与人工智能的协作方面具有非同寻常的挑战性。 该猜想由佩雷尔曼证明，指出每个单连通、闭的三维流形都与三维球面同胚。 我们遵循摩根–田的详细阐述 [ 32 ] 。 该证明需要几何分析，而 Mathlib 目前仍缺乏成熟的可重用接口，因此构建基础架构成为该项目不可或缺的一部分。

paragraphs.en: Our preparation began in May 2026 with three AI engineers with mathematical training, who worked alongside a group of mathematicians. Over the following months, we developed a natural-language blueprint of the proof and formalized some background material. Drawing on this preparation, we substantially redesigned our workflow and restarted the main formalization in September with about 90 milestones, each specifying the definitions and Lean statement required for its target. The milestones provided shared mathematical targets, exposed dependencies, and made progress and blockers visible. The engineers used this structure to coordinate parallel agent work, while mathematicians reviewed the final theorem and key intermediate statements and helped resolve mathematical difficulties during proof construction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的准备工作始于 2026 年 5 月，当时有三名具备数学背景的 AI 工程师与一群数学家并肩合作。 在接下来的几个月里，我们制定了该证明的自然语言蓝图，并对部分背景材料进行了形式化。 基于这一准备工作，我们对工作流程进行了大幅重新设计，并于 9 月重启了主要形式化工作，共设定了约 90 个里程碑，每个里程碑都明确了其目标所需的定义和 Lean 陈述。 这些里程碑提供了共同的数学目标，揭示了依赖关系，并使进展和障碍清晰可见。 工程师们利用这一结构来协调智能体的并行工作，而数学家则负责审查最终定理和关键中间陈述，并在证明构建过程中协助解决数学难题。

paragraphs.en: Using publicly available commercial models, we completed the main formalization phase in slightly more than two weeks, after the initial preparation phase. AI subscriptions and server rentals cost about $25,000. The resulting development proves both the topological and smooth Poincaré theorems. 1 1 1 An independent formalization of the Poincaré conjecture was also announced by Ziyang Qin, Yuan Liao, Bennett Chow, Ayush Khaitan, and Jack McCarthy [ 14 ] . It passes a full Lean build and Comparator verification against target statements written using only Mathlib. 2 2 2 The repository includes the independent target statements and verification instructions. Comparator checks statement agreement and permitted axioms; our configuration also checks the proofs with the independent Nanoda kernel. The initial development contained about 3.2 3.2 million lines of Lean code. 3 3 3 Both figures count Lean source lines after removing comments, using the versions before and after PR #3 , respectively. Extracting the dependencies of the final theorem reduced it to about 2.8 2.8 million lines while preserving verification.

paragraphs.en: Lean 4 is a programming language and proof assistant in which mathematics is formulated as code: definitions, theorem statements, and proofs are all written in Lean, and compiling the code checks each proof against its statement in Lean’s kernel [ 13 ] . A proof that passes kernel checking is guaranteed to establish its statement, without any need to read the proof itself. Its community library, Mathlib, provides reusable mathematical definitions and theorems [ 48 ] . At the start of our project, however, Mathlib lacked much of the reusable formal infrastructure required for the geometric analysis in the Poincaré proof. Outside Mathlib, relevant formal developments were also limited and dispersed across individual projects. An early contribution during our preparatory phase was Chow et al.’s formalization of Hamilton’s three-manifold theorem [ 11 ] . 4 4 4 The public Lean source tree records selected adaptations from Differential Geometry in Lean 4 [ 14 ] , including its adapted De Giorgi material [ 4 , 3 ] , as well as from ClassificationOfSurfaces [ 43 ] , Tau Ceti [ 46 ] , and Mathlib [ 48 ] . The fixed upstream revisions and file-level scopes are documented in the repository’s MODIFICATIONS.md . Our Poincaré formalization was developed independently of the contemporaneous work of Qin et al. [ 39 ] . The developments use different Ricci-flow interfaces and final proof assemblies; ours follows separately designed and reviewed milestones based on Morgan–Tian.
paragraphs.zh: Lean 4 是一种编程语言兼证明辅助工具，其中数学以代码形式构建：定义、定理陈述和证明均在 Lean 中编写，而代码的编译过程会在 Lean 的核心中验证每个证明是否符合其对应的陈述 [ 13 ]。 通过核心验证的证明能够确保其陈述成立，无需阅读证明本身。 其社区库 Mathlib 提供了可重用的数学定义和定理 [ 48 ]。 然而，在我们项目初期，Mathlib 缺乏庞加莱证明中几何分析所需的大部分可重用形式化基础设施。 在 Mathlib 之外，相关的形式化成果也十分有限，且分散在各个独立项目中。 在准备阶段，Chow 等人对哈密顿三维流形定理的形式化工作 [ 11 ] 是一项早期贡献。4 4 4 Lean 的公开源代码树记录了《Lean 4 微分几何》[ 14 ] 中部分改编内容，包括其改编后的 De Giorgi 材料 [ 4 , 3 ]，以及来自《曲面分类》[ 43 ]、Tau Ceti [ 46 ] 和 Mathlib [ 48 ] 的内容。 固定的上游修订版本和文件级作用域已记录在仓库的 MODIFICATIONS.md 文件中。 我们的庞加莱形式化工作是独立于 Qin 等人 [ 39 ] 同期研究而开发的。 这些成果使用了不同的里奇流接口和最终的证明组合方式；我们的方案则遵循了基于 Morgan–Tian 理论、经过独立设计与评审的里程碑。

paragraphs.en: Early work on autoformalization studied the translation of informal mathematical statements into formal languages [ 51 , 53 ] . Subsequent research developed datasets and methods for statement formalization in Lean [ 26 , 18 , 31 , 50 ] . In parallel, language models advanced proof generation for given formal goals [ 38 , 54 , 40 , 23 ] . These directions also interact: DSP showed how natural language proofs could guide formal proof construction [ 27 ] , while subsequent work studied the translation of both statements and proofs into Lean [ 25 ] . Agent systems build on these capabilities, using library retrieval and proof-assistant feedback to carry out and revise sequences of proof tasks [ 47 , 30 , 28 ] . Recent projects have also extended autoformalization to mathematical developments containing many interdependent results [ 49 , 52 , 19 ] . In September 2026, the formalization of Fermat’s Last Theorem using Prove2Me produced a complete computer-checked proof. Its published account emphasizes the resulting development while giving less detail about the division of human and AI work [ 9 , 2 ] . The challenge addressed here is to extend this approach to the Poincaré proof while developing much of the geometric analysis absent from existing reusable libraries.
paragraphs.zh: 早期的自动形式化研究探讨了将非正式的数学陈述翻译成形式化语言的方法 [ 51 , 53 ] 。 后续的研究为在 Lean 中实现陈述的形式化开发了数据集和方法 [ 26 , 18 , 31 , 50 ] 。 与此同时，语言模型在给定形式化目标时的证明生成能力也得到了提升 [ 38 , 54 , 40 , 23 ] 。 这些方向也存在相互作用：DSP 展示了自然语言证明如何指导形式化证明的构建 [ 27 ] ，而后续研究则探讨了将陈述和证明一同翻译成 Lean 的方法 [ 25 ] 。 智能体系统在这些能力的基础上进一步发展，通过调用库资源和获取证明辅助工具的反馈来执行并修订一系列证明任务 [ 47 , 30 , 28 ] 。 近期的项目还将自动形式化的应用扩展到了包含大量相互依赖结果的数学发展体系中 [ 49 , 52 , 19 ] 。 2026 年 9 月，使用 Prove2Me 对费马大定理进行形式化，最终生成了一份完整的计算机验证证明。 其公开发表的报告重点描述了由此实现的进展，但对人类与人工智能之间的分工细节着墨较少 [ 9 , 2 ] 。 本文要解决的挑战是，将这种方法扩展到庞加莱的证明中，同时开发现有可重用库中缺失的大部分内容几何分析。

paragraphs.en: During the initial phase, we collected books and papers on Riemannian geometry [ 15 , 37 , 17 , 41 , 7 ] , algebraic topology [ 22 ] , PDEs [ 16 ] , three-manifold topology [ 42 , 32 ] , and Ricci flow [ 10 , 12 , 20 , 21 , 44 , 45 , 34 , 36 , 35 , 6 ] . We initially planned to formalize substantial portions of this background before addressing the Poincaré conjecture itself. This approach progressed slowly, and the resulting Lean code did not meet our expectations for quality or organization. The reasons for this difference in performance are discussed in Section 4.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 在初始阶段，我们收集了关于黎曼几何 [ 15 , 37 , 17 , 41 , 7 ]、代数拓扑 [ 22 ]、偏微分方程（PDEs）[ 16 ]、三维流形拓扑 [ 42 , 32 ] 以及里奇流 [ 10 , 12 , 20 , 21 , 44 , 45 , 34 , 36 , 35 , 6 ] 的书籍和论文。 我们最初计划在处理庞加莱猜想本身之前，将这部分背景知识的大部分内容形式化。 这种方法进展缓慢，且最终生成的 Lean 代码在质量或组织性方面未能达到我们的预期。 关于这种性能差异的原因，将在第 4.3 节中讨论。

paragraphs.en: By late July, we had completed a Lean formalization of the Hopf–Rinow theorem and reviewed its mathematical correctness. After an initial attempt with an AI system failed, a mathematician reorganized the proof into a clearer route, enabling the system to complete the development. Throughout August, we continued formalizing foundational material from these sources and completed a natural-language blueprint of the Poincaré proof following Morgan–Tian.
paragraphs.zh: 到七月底，我们完成了对霍普夫–里诺定理的精益形式化，并审查了其数学正确性。 在首次尝试使用人工智能系统失败后，一位数学家重新组织了证明过程，使其路径更清晰，从而让该系统得以完成开发。 整个八月，我们继续对这些来源中的基础材料进行形式化，并按照摩根–田的方法完成了对庞加莱证明的自然语言蓝图。

paragraphs.en: Drawing on this preparation, we redesigned the workflow summarized in Figure 1 . We collected the relevant sources, corrections, and repositories, and organized them into a proof skeleton following the Morgan–Tian exposition [ 32 ] . This skeleton consisted of 90 milestones distributed throughout the intended argument. Each milestone included a Lean statement and the definitions required by that statement. The resulting milestone interfaces were then used for parallel work across independent tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这一准备工作，我们重新设计了图 1 中概述的工作流程。 我们收集了相关来源、修正和存储库，并按照 Morgan–Tian 的阐述 [32] 将它们组织成一个证明框架。 该框架由分布在预期论证过程中的 90 个里程碑组成。 每个里程碑都包含一个 Lean 陈述以及该陈述所需的定义。 随后，这些生成的里程碑接口被用于独立任务之间的并行工作。

paragraphs.en: The milestone statements were reviewed by mathematicians in parallel with the formalization work. This review established a common standard for the principal results and helped prevent the growing codebase from diverging from the intended mathematics. Since it was not possible to review every line of agent-generated code, the milestone statements provided checkpoints at which the mathematical content could be examined independently of the eventual implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 数学家们在形式化工作的同时，也对这些里程碑陈述进行了并行审查。 这项审查为主干成果确立了统一的标准，并有助于防止不断增长的代码库偏离预期的数学内容。 由于无法审查智能体生成的每一行代码，因此这些里程碑陈述提供了检查点，使得数学内容能够脱离最终的实现方式而独立检验。

paragraphs.en: The milestone structure also exposed the dependency chains in the proof. For each milestone, agents were asked to use the mathematical references to produce an informal proof sketch and to identify the results on which the milestone depended. These sketches made dependencies visible and helped group related milestones into larger tasks, for example when several milestones required the same underlying infrastructure. Because the project used several autoformalization pipelines, the reviewed milestone statements also served as common interfaces between those pipelines.
paragraphs.zh: 这个里程碑结构也揭示了证明中的依赖链。 对于每个里程碑，智能体被要求使用数学参考资料来生成一个非正式的证明草图，并确定该里程碑所依赖的结果。 这些草图使依赖关系变得清晰，并有助于将相关的里程碑分组为更大的任务，例如当多个里程碑需要相同的底层基础设施时。 由于该项目使用了多个自动形式化流程，经过审查的里程碑陈述也充当了这些流程之间的通用接口。

sents.en: Because the project used several autoformalization pipelines, the reviewed milestone statements also served as common interfaces between those pipelines.
sents.zh: 由于该项目使用了多个自动形式化流程，经过审查的里程碑陈述也充当了这些流程之间的通用接口。

paragraphs.en: Some tasks required direct human supervision, often simply by bypassing an agent’s self-imposed constraints or correcting a subtle logical gap. Interactive sessions with coding agents such as Codex and Claude Code were used to monitor progress, identify unproductive proof attempts, and diagnose blockers. In many cases, a discussion with the agent was enough to unblock a task. In other cases, supervision exposed an inconsistency in a frozen Lean statement. Such statements were not changed by the agents; the issue was instead reviewed by the relevant mathematicians and corrected at the coordination level.
paragraphs.zh: 某些任务需要直接的人工监督，通常只需绕过智能体自我设定的限制，或修正其逻辑中细微的漏洞。 通过与 Codex 和 Claude Code 等编码智能体的互动会话，可以监控进展、识别无益的证明尝试，并诊断出阻碍任务推进的问题。 在许多情况下，与智能体进行一次讨论就足以解除任务中的障碍。 在其他情况下，监督过程则暴露出某个被冻结的 Lean 陈述中存在的不一致之处。 这类陈述并未由智能体修改；相反，相关问题由相关数学家进行审查，并在协调层面予以修正。

paragraphs.en: The human role therefore remained focused on mathematical scope, statement review, task prioritization, and the resolution of exceptional difficulties. This division of labor made it possible to supervise the development at a high level without inspecting every agent action or every line of Lean code. Once a task satisfied its milestone interface, its changes could be merged into the shared repository. This experience showed that the organization of the formalization process was as important as the capabilities of the underlying agents.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，人类的角色仍然专注于数学范围、陈述审查、任务优先级排序以及解决特殊困难。 这种分工使得能够在高层面上监督开发进程，而无需检查每个智能体的行动或每一行 Lean 代码。 一旦某个任务满足其里程碑接口，其变更就可以合并到共享存储库中。 这段经历表明，形式化过程的组织方式与底层智能体的能力同样重要。

paragraphs.en: Statement review was the checkpoint at which we assessed the mathematical target independently of its proof. For each milestone, reviewers examined whether the definitions, hypotheses, conclusion, and intended dependencies expressed the result required by the proof route. The final theorem statements were kept separate from the supporting proof modules, so that a reviewer could evaluate what Lean was asked to prove without reconstructing an agent’s proof history.
paragraphs.zh: 陈述审查是我们独立于其证明过程来评估数学目标的检查点。 对于每个里程碑，评审员都会检查定义、假设、结论以及所依赖的意图是否表达了证明路线所需的结果。 最终的定理陈述与支撑性的证明模块保持分离，这样评审员就能在不重建智能体的证明历史的情况下，评估 Lean 被要求证明的内容。

paragraphs.zh: 每个陈述都附有其数学来源、相关修正、依赖关系以及预期的通用性程度。 审查记录将这些选择与相应的 Lean 声明关联起来，并记录了后续的修订。 这使得陈述审查成为一个独立且可审计的阶段，而不是成功编译所推导出的结果。

paragraphs.en: The review had two passes. The first checked the written definitions and statement against the mathematical sources and downstream uses. The second inspected the declaration produced by Lean’s elaborator, including information left implicit in the source code, to detect unintended parameters or assumptions. Statement types were also required to be independent of admitted proofs. These checks validated the target as a basis for proof construction; they did not by themselves prove the theorem.
paragraphs.zh: 该审查分为两个阶段。 第一阶段将书面定义和陈述与数学来源及下游应用进行了核对。 第二阶段检查了 Lean 的展开器生成的声明，包括源代码中未明确说明的信息，以检测意外参数或假设。 陈述类型也必须独立于已接受的证明。 这些检查验证了目标可作为构造证明的基础；但它们本身并未证明该定理。

sents.zh: 第一阶段将书面定义和陈述与数学来源及下游应用进行了核对。

paragraphs.en: Mathematicians participated from the statement-design stage and resolved ambiguities before they propagated into dependent tasks. When review found that a shared statement needed correction, the coordinator recorded the revised basis and reopened the affected reviews; unaffected milestones could continue. Human intervention therefore controlled the mathematical scope while preserving the distinction between a reviewed statement and a mechanically checked proof.
paragraphs.zh: 数学家们从陈述设计阶段就参与其中，并在模糊性演变为依赖任务之前予以解决。 当审查发现共享陈述需要修正时，协调员会记录修订后的基础，并重新开启受影响的审查；未受影响的里程碑则可以继续推进。 因此，人工干预既控制了数学范围，又保留了已审查陈述与机械验证证明之间的区别。

paragraphs.en: Milestone design was a joint mathematical and engineering task. Mathematicians selected a coherent proof route, supplied arguments and references, and identified intermediate results that could be reviewed independently. Engineers and Lean experts assessed the available formal infrastructure and the work needed to connect those results in Lean. Named theorems in the Morgan–Tian exposition provided initial landmarks; a usable formalization blueprint also had to specify the definitions, supporting constructions, and dependencies between them. The milestones therefore reflected both the logical structure of the mathematics and the practical organization of its implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 里程碑设计是一项联合的数学与工程任务。 数学家们选择了一条连贯的证明路径，提供了论证和参考文献，并确定了可以独立审查的中间结果。 工程师和精益专家评估了现有的形式化基础设施，以及将这些结果在 Lean 中连接起来所需的工作。 Morgan–Tian 论述中命名的定理提供了最初的里程碑；一个可用的形式化蓝图还必须明确定义这些定理的定义、辅助构造以及它们之间的依赖关系。 因此，这些里程碑既反映了数学的逻辑结构，也体现了其实现的实践组织方式。

paragraphs.en: In choosing the spacing between milestones, we considered the expected amount of Lean code and prerequisite development. A short deduction on paper may require substantial formal work when suitable definitions, estimates, or links between representations are missing. Such gaps warranted additional intermediate tasks. Conversely, closely related results could share a task when they depended on the same construction. This assessment concerned the work needed to produce a useful, reviewable result, rather than a fixed number of textbook pages or lines of code.
paragraphs.zh: 在确定里程碑之间的间隔时，我们考虑了预期的精益代码量以及前置开发工作。 纸上简短的推导，如果缺少合适的定义、估算或表示形式之间的关联，可能需要大量的正式工作。 这类差距需要增加额外的中间任务。 相反，如果相关结果依赖于相同的构建过程，它们就可以共享一个任务。 这种评估关注的是生成一个有用且可审查的结果所需的工作，而不是固定的教科书页数或代码行数。

paragraphs.en: The appropriate level of generality was also a design choice. To simplify formalization, a result could be specialized to dimension three, or restricted to a weaker conclusion, when that was sufficient for every subsequent use. Other milestones benefited from stronger conclusions: returning a constructed object together with the properties needed later could avoid repeated constructions and proofs of compatibility. The annulus and deformation stages illustrate this choice in Section 4.2 . Such revisions required mathematical review to ensure that the final theorem remained supported and that additional conclusions were proved from justified assumptions. Agents could report a difficulty, but changes to an agreed target were coordinated explicitly.
paragraphs.zh: 适当的普遍性程度也是一种设计选择。 为简化形式化过程，当某个结果对后续所有使用都足够时，可以将其特化为三维情况，或限制为较弱的结论。 其他里程碑得益于更强的结论：返回一个构造出的对象以及后续所需的性质，可以避免重复构造和兼容性证明。 第 4.2 节中的环面和形变阶段说明了这一选择。 此类修订需要进行数学审查，以确保最终定理仍然成立，并且额外的结论是从有充分依据的假设中推导出来的。 智能体可以报告困难，但对已商定目标的任何修改都需要明确协调。

paragraphs.en: Each milestone specified its definitions, assumptions, and required outputs before proof assignment. A directed dependency graph recorded which earlier constructions or results each task would use. Shared foundations were assigned to a single owner, and independent tasks were developed in separate workspaces using agreed definitions and statements. As implementation exposed missing prerequisites or unsuitable task boundaries, we revised the graph and the affected assignments while allowing unaffected work to continue.
paragraphs.zh: 每个里程碑在分配证明任务之前，都明确了其定义、假设和所需输出。 一个有向依赖图记录了每项任务会用到哪些先前的构建或结果。 共享基础部分被指定给单一负责人，而独立任务则在单独的工作空间中开发，并使用已商定的定义和陈述。 随着实施过程中暴露出缺失的先决条件或不合适的任务边界，我们修订了依赖图和相关分配方案，同时允许未受影响的工作继续推进。

sents.zh: 每个里程碑在分配证明任务之前，都明确了其定义、假设和所需输出。

paragraphs.en: This structure made expert guidance useful throughout execution. Mathematicians with a high-level view of the proof and relevant formalization-engineering experience could often identify a missing argument, an unsuitable target, or a dependency problem early, and give effective guidance before extensive code accumulated. Engineers could then translate that diagnosis into revised tasks and dependencies. The combination of mathematical judgment, Lean implementation experience, and automated proof construction therefore provided a practical basis for coordinating and reviewing a development too large to inspect line by line.
paragraphs.zh: 这种结构使得专家指导在整个执行过程中都很有用。 对证明有高层次理解且具备相关形式化工程经验的数学家，通常能及早发现缺失的论证、不合适的目标或依赖性问题，并在大量代码积累之前提供有效指导。 工程师随后可以将这种诊断转化为修订后的任务和依赖关系。 因此，数学判断力、Lean 实现经验以及自动证明构建的结合，为协调和审查一个无法逐行检查的大型开发项目提供了实用基础。

paragraphs.en: The formalization of the Poincaré conjecture involved three AI engineers, together with mathematicians and Lean experts. This diversity made it possible to use complementary methods of autoformalization, but also required coordination to avoid duplicated work, incompatible interfaces, and conflicting versions of the same result.

paragraphs.en: For different scales and failure modes, we primarily used two complementary modes: interactive coding-agent sessions for tightly scoped, high-context interventions, and a distributed mission workflow for proof branches that could be decomposed and run in parallel. The first mode used interactive sessions, principally with Codex and Claude Code. Each session was organized around a proof-branch harness rather than an isolated coding prompt. Before an agent began, an engineer fixed the branch boundary, milestone endpoint, definitions and interfaces to be used, predecessor and consumer dependencies, relevant mathematical sources, expected artifacts, and compilation and admission checks. The engineer then used the session to search and filter the pinned Mathlib APIs and source references, translate the selected argument, monitor the resulting declarations, and revise the route when a mathematical or implementation obstruction appeared. This architecture kept local proof search tied to the surrounding dependency graph. GPT-6-Astra carried most of the long-context statement formalization and proof construction, while Fable-5.1 was used for independent source-alignment checks, diagnosis of blocked branches, and refinement of the proposed harness. This division of labor proved effective in practice: one model could sustain the main construction while the other supplied targeted scrutiny and alternative directions.
paragraphs.zh: 针对不同的规模和故障模式，我们主要采用了两种互补的模式：用于范围明确、上下文复杂干预的交互式编码-智能体会话，以及用于可分解并行运行的证明分支的分布式任务工作流。 第一种模式采用交互式会话，主要使用 Codex 和 Claude Code。 每次会话都围绕一个证明分支框架组织，而非孤立的编码提示。 在智能体开始之前，工程师会确定分支边界、里程碑终点、待使用的定义与接口、前置与依赖项、相关数学资源、预期产物以及编译与准入检查。 随后，工程师利用该会话搜索并筛选已固定的 Mathlib API 和源参考，翻译选定的论证，监控生成的声明，并在出现数学或实现障碍时调整路线。 这种架构使局部证明搜索始终与周围的依赖图保持关联。 GPT-6-Astra 承担了大部分长上下文陈述的形式化和证明构建工作，而 Fable-5.1 则用于独立的源对齐检查、受阻分支的诊断以及所提框架的优化。 这种分工在实践中被证明是有效的：一个模型可以维持主要构建过程，而另一个模型则提供针对性的审查和替代方向。

paragraphs.en: The second method used Archon Horizon. 5 5 5 https://github.com/frenzymath/Archon-Horizon Archon Horizon is a distributed control plane for formalization projects. It represents a project as a collection of bounded missions with explicit goals, dependencies, and completion conditions, rather than as one long interactive session. paragraphs.en: This structure supports parallel execution. Horizon can dispatch independent missions to agents running on different configured servers, while shared repositories and communication channels maintain a common view of the project. This reduces local computing bottlenecks and allows several formalization tasks to progress concurrently. Engineers can still supervise the system through interactive agent sessions: they can inspect progress, supply context, launch or cancel missions, and intervene when a task appears blocked. Horizon therefore combines distributed execution with the possibility of targeted human oversight.
paragraphs.zh: 该结构支持并行执行。 Horizon 可以将独立任务分配给运行在不同配置服务器上的智能体，同时共享存储库和通信通道能维持对项目的全局统一视图。 这减少了本地计算瓶颈，并使多个形式化任务能够同步推进。 工程师仍可通过交互式智能体会话对系统进行监督：他们可以检查进展、提供上下文信息、启动或取消任务，并在任务出现阻塞时进行干预。 因此，Horizon 将分布式执行与针对性的人工监督相结合。

paragraphs.en: Because the engineers used different methods and servers, coordination required a shared repository. Contributors claimed milestones there and submitted completed work through pull requests. An integration bot independently compiled the Lean code and automatically merged accepted changes. When a peer completed a milestone, the other engineers could incorporate the resulting changes into their own workspaces and continue from the updated development.
paragraphs.zh: 由于工程师们使用了不同的方法和服务器，因此协调工作需要一个共享存储库。 贡献者在此处标记里程碑，并通过拉取请求提交已完成的工作。 一个集成机器人能够独立编译 Lean 代码，并自动合并已接受的更改。 当一位同行完成某个里程碑时，其他工程师可以将由此产生的更改整合到自己的工作区中，并从更新后的开发状态继续工作。

paragraphs.en: Agents typically worked through repeated cycles of source and library search, informal reasoning, Lean implementation, and compilation. They assisted with translating arguments, connecting existing results, repairing local proofs, and checking code mechanically. Recurring difficulties arose when a task required judging whether a stronger claim followed from the reference, whether two representations described the same geometric object, or whether an intermediate result would help prove the final theorem. These decisions required review beyond checking whether individual code fragments compiled.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体通常通过源文件和库的重复搜索、非正式推理、Lean 实现和编译等循环流程来开展工作。 它们协助翻译论证、连接已有成果、修复局部证明，并对代码进行机械化检查。 当任务需要判断某个更强的结论是否可从参考材料中推导出来、两种表示是否描述了相同的几何对象，或者某个中间结果是否有助于证明最终定理时，反复出现的困难便会显现。 这些决策所需的审查工作，已超越了单纯检查单个代码片段能否成功编译的范畴。

paragraphs.en: When progress stalled, we found that the difficulties mainly fell into three categories, which helped us address each one at its source:

paragraphs.en: Mathematical gaps. These required a more detailed argument, a suitable reference, or a reviewed correction to the statement or its hypotheses.
paragraphs.zh: 数学上的漏洞。 这些漏洞需要一个更详细的论证、一个合适的参考，或者对陈述及其假设的经过审核的修正。

paragraphs.en: Failed attempts also supplied diagnostic evidence. paragraphs.en: Mathematicians contributed to the design and progress of the formalization through choices about scope, proof strategy, and the information passed between tasks. paragraphs.en: The third concerned comparing and deforming families of curves (M64–M65). paragraphs.en: After redesigning the workflow in September as described in Section 3 , we completed the main formalization phase in slightly more than two weeks. This acceleration did not arise simply from asking agents to work faster or from allocating more compute: the earlier project had already produced roughly 500,000 comment-free lines of book-based Lean source, as well as a blueprint and tracked many individual nodes. This earlier source collection was separate from the later full development, whose dependency cone contains about 2.8 2.8 million of the original 3.2 3.2 million lines. The central change was to turn a comparatively small collection of reviewed milestone statements into fixed interfaces for the entire project.
paragraphs.zh: 在九月按照第 3 节所述重新设计工作流程后，我们在两周多一点的时间里完成了主要的形式化阶段。 这种加速并非仅仅通过要求智能体加快工作速度或分配更多计算资源而实现的：早期项目已经生成了大约 50 万行不含注释的基于书籍的 Lean 源代码，以及一份蓝图，并追踪了许多单个节点。 这一早期的源代码收集工作与后续的整体开发相分离，其依赖锥包含原始 320 万行代码中的约 280 万行。 核心变化在于，将一组相对较小的已审查里程碑声明转化为整个项目的固定接口。

paragraphs.en: Earlier tasks were often broad, for example formalizing a chapter, a section of the blueprint, or a node in a dependency graph. Such tasks could produce substantial verified progress while still lacking a precise and independently checkable endpoint, making progress difficult to review and the causes of blockers difficult to identify. In the redesigned workflow, the proof was organized around 90 milestone statements distributed throughout the intended argument. Each statement specified the assumptions and conclusion to be preserved, its dependencies, and the condition under which the corresponding task could be considered complete. The milestone therefore provided a concrete location at which progress could be inspected and the mathematical content reviewed.
paragraphs.zh: 早期的任务通常范围较广，例如将某个章节、蓝图中的某个部分或依赖图中的某个节点形式化。 这类任务虽然能带来显著的验证进展，但往往仍缺乏一个精确且可独立验证的终点，导致进展难以评估，阻碍因素的原因也难以识别。 在重新设计的工作流程中，证明过程围绕 90 个分布在整个预期论证中的里程碑陈述展开。 每个陈述都明确了需要保留的假设和结论、其依赖项，以及满足何种条件时对应的任务才能被视为完成。 因此，这些里程碑提供了一个具体的节点，用于检查进展并审查数学内容。

paragraphs.en: The timing of review also changed, mitigating the human-review bottleneck. In the earlier attempts, Lean code was reviewed after it had been formalized, making it difficult for human feedback to shape the tasks assigned to the autoformalization system. In the new workflow, mathematicians reviewed the central milestone statements before, or in parallel with, their formalization. These reviewed statements constrained subsequent agent work and reduced the risk that many locally successful proofs would accumulate around an unsuitable definition or an incorrect formulation of a major result.

paragraphs.en: The new structure made both progress and blockers easier to understand. For example, the earlier Ricci-flow work encountered separate difficulties in curvature evolution, maximum-principle arguments, derivative estimates, and endpoint regularity. The milestone decomposition made interfaces between these arguments explicit, instead of leaving them as unresolved parts of a single large analytic task. We could then identify whether a blocked task required a missing lemma, a more detailed informal argument, an additional reference, further decomposition, or a revision of the statement.
paragraphs.zh: 这种新结构让进展和障碍都更容易理解。 例如，早期的 Ricci-flow 研究在曲率演化、最大原理论证、导数估计和终点正则性方面分别遇到了不同的困难。 里程碑分解让这些论证之间的接口变得明确，而不是让它们成为单一大型分析任务中未解决的部分。 这样我们就能判断某个受阻的任务是缺少引理、需要更详细的非正式论证、需要补充参考文献、需要进一步分解，还是需要对命题本身进行修订。

paragraphs.en: Frozen milestone statements also made parallel work practical. They were particularly well suited to a framework such as Archon Horizon, which assigns bounded tasks to different agents and servers. paragraphs.en: The projects nevertheless share an important organizational principle. Anthropic reports that early FLT attempts failed in part because agents lost track of the evolving project state. Their successful workflow used Prove2Me [ 9 ] to maintain a directed acyclic graph of statements, separate statements from proofs, and support search and reuse through descriptions of the available results [ 2 , 9 ] . Our workflow similarly used explicit dependencies and fixed statement interfaces to coordinate parallel proof efforts. The main difference is that our milestones were selected in advance from the Morgan–Tian route and reviewed by mathematicians before, or while, formalization proceeded. These reviewed statements served as stable interfaces between several independent pipelines. This suggests that successful autoformalization depends not only on stronger agents or greater parallelism. Without a sufficiently structured workflow, either approach can eventually reach a point at which accumulated inconsistencies, unresolved dependencies, or loss of project state make a restart necessary, as occurred in the early attempts of both projects. The organization of the project appears to have contributed to this result: careful preparation before formalization, followed by explicit task decomposition, stable interfaces, and coordination throughout execution.

paragraphs.en: Using publicly available models, we formalized the Poincaré conjecture together with much of its prerequisite theory. For this project, several months of preparation supplied the proof blueprint and informed the milestone structure. Preparing the milestones required organizing the proof route, dividing it into units of manageable formalization size, and making their dependencies explicit. This structure made parallel work possible and helped us locate problems that required mathematical judgment. Experts provided high-level guidance when statements needed revision or proof attempts stalled. This experience shows that an independent research team can achieve large-scale formal verification with human–AI collaboration. As models improve, we expect them to take on more of the mathematical preparation and substantially shorten the time required by the formalization process.

paragraphs.en: In the public snapshot, about 48 % 48\% of the Lean source is devoted to background theory and shared mathematical infrastructure. 6 6 6 This classification is based on GPT-6-Astra’s assessment, which we prompted to distinguish source devoted to the Perelman proof from background and supporting theory. The classification refers to commit 3d7318c . Examples include Bishop–Gromov volume comparison, short-time existence for Ricci flow, Shi’s derivative estimates, the Hurewicz theorem, and the smooth Schoenflies theorem in dimension three; representative declarations are listed in Appendix 6.1 . For example, our development of smooth structures on compact connected topological three-manifolds spans about 650,000 650{,}000 lines of Lean, including supporting theory, although Morgan–Tian invokes this classical result in an opening footnote. Reliable, reusable mathematical infrastructure is central to reducing the difficulty and cost of formalization. The key is to provide carefully reviewed definitions and theorem statements that accurately express the intended mathematics and can be reused across projects. Such libraries can reduce the need to rebuild foundational theory in every project. An important direction for future work is to turn the material from this project, including its many intermediate formalizations of results, into a maintained geometric-analysis library. This requires reviewing its mathematical interfaces, removing duplication, and improving its organization and documentation. Its success should be judged by how much work and cost it saves in later formalizations. Meanwhile, the proof blueprint can be refined into a clearer mathematical account of the Poincaré argument, making its dependencies explicit and clarifying the role of its intermediate conclusions.

paragraphs.en: As proof generation and formal verification become cheaper, we hope that affordable tools will let an independent mathematician easily use formalization to verify their own research: stating goals, preparing milestones, guiding proof construction, reviewing formal statements, and finally obtaining mechanically verified results. At a broader level, formalization can also help clarify and improve mathematics itself. In a separate Laver-function formalization project, our formalization identified corrections and clarifications that were incorporated into a revised paper [ 8 ] . For the Poincaré conjecture, however, much remains to be done to re-examine its proof mathematically with the help of formalization. The formalization has also revealed potential for mathematical revisions that could correct or simplify parts of the argument and deepen our understanding of its structure. We believe that formalization, if done properly, can help mathematicians reorganize mathematics by clarifying definitions, making dependencies explicit, and revealing connections between arguments. To make this capability accessible to the mathematical community more broadly, we invite mathematicians to carry their high-level mathematical knowledge into human–AI interactions centered on Lean, and to help build the libraries, tools, and practices this development requires.
